Name: Only Fish Consume Bait
Author: MercuryVN
Description:
[b][size=4]Mod detail[/size]
[/b][size=3]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/116553368]atravita[/url]'s mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11426]Trash Does Not Consume Bait[/url], this mod (only) attempted to prevent anything other than fish to consume your bait when fishing without tamper with the game code. Any feedback is welcome.[/size]

[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[size=3]Extract and put in the Mods folder[/size]

[size=4][b]Config
[/b][/size][size=3]Run the game with this mod at least once to generate config.json file
Options:
[list]
[*][size=3]ToggleModButton: button to toggle the mod on or off, default is none (no keybind)[/size]
[*][size=3]EnableMod: Whether the mod is on or off, default is true[/size]
[/list]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[/size]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]Only tested on Windows[/size]
[size=3]Have not tested if there are mods conflict
Have not tested in multiplayer, but it should be compatible

[size=4][b]Limitation[/b][/size]
[size=3]If you notice that you get an addtional bait when hooking anything other than fish. Worry not I make sure that additional bait is not exploitable (probably)[/size]

[/size][b][size=4]External[/size][/b]
[size=3]Source code: [url=https://github.com/MercuryVN/OnlyFishConsumeBait]Github[/url][/size]

Require SMAPI
